summary: Completed iteration 2 public API and UI regression testing. Backend transaction reconciliation, current-month dashboard totals, persisted reports, CSV import, and CRUD pass. Live desktop/mobile UI flows pass for dashboard, transaction create/delete, calendar navigation, reports route, and currency selector.

ui_bugs.issue: The dashboard eyebrow is still hardcoded as SALı, 18 MART 2025 while live transactions and calendar are in September 2026.

integration_issues.issue: Both report cards' Raporu görüntüle buttons are clickable but have no handler, navigation, or visible result.
Hesap ekle and Cari ekle only show a 'yakında hazır' toast; no create flow is available.

action_items: Derive the dashboard date eyebrow from the current locale date instead of hardcoding March 2025.
Implement report-card actions or remove the misleading buttons until report result views exist.
Add account and cari-account create CRUD flows if those management requirements are in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard still contains hardcoded date and month-over-month detail strings, which can contradict live financial data.
Interactive report buttons and account/contact add controls are rendered without functional handlers; this is misleading for a finance-management MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows pass; 3 remaining functional gaps reported)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ API records and one UI_TEST current-date income; all temporary records were deleted. Demo records were not intentionally modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and core UI regression are green. Recheck dashboard date derivation, report actions, and account/contact CRUD after fixes. Calendar current-month heading and previous/next navigation now pass.
rca of the issue: The dashboard eyebrow remains a literal string in Dashboard while the calendar was updated to cursor-based dates. Reports and add controls render buttons without onClick/business flows, so clicks produce no state change or navigation.
